name: spec-driven-development
instructions:
Run spec-driven development (SDD): a constitution for repo-local rules, then specify, plan, and tasks as durable artifacts, then implement against them - compatible with GitHub Spec Kit's /specify, /plan, /tasks workflow.

Capabilities:
- author and maintain a repository constitution
- produce a spec artifact from intent (specify phase)
- produce a plan artifact with architecture and seams (plan phase)
- decompose the plan into tracer-bullet tasks (tasks phase)
- verify implementation against the spec and plan

Canonical skill: .agents/skills/project/spec-driven-development/SKILL.md
handoff_description: Constitution, spec, plan, and tasks exist as durable artifacts and the implementation verifies against them.
